d: Cristiano Ronaldo gave Portugal 23 years, 234 appearances and 146 international goals. His farewell should have been a night to celebrate one of the greatest careers in international football. Instead, Portugal's first match after Ronaldo's international retirement ended in a humiliating 4-1 defeat to Denmark at UEFA Nations League, with fans booing their own team. But the bigger questions surround Ronaldo's absence, his strained relationship with Jorge Jesus and the way Portugal handled his goodbye. Rupha Ramani looks at why Cristiano Ronaldo deserved a far better farewell.
